terminalBlockers: C5-SEMANTIC-OWNER-COMPRESSION must be terminal before UIUX-CONVERGE-0 can be done
UXW-14 must rerun CAPABILITY-CLOSURE-E2 after the complete UIUX slice
E3-HUMAN remains external for representative comprehension, efficiency, pleasantness and assistive-technology effectiveness
designIntent: Make the current E2-closed ICTC product feel and behave like one deliberately designed professional workbench: minimal first plane, dense scannable work rows, one semantic owner per slot, local specialization, explicit epistemic boundaries, bounded motion, and no new business authority.

abstractionMatrix.name: foundations
abstractionMatrix.rule: tokens only; no surface-specific semantic truth

abstractionMatrix.name: controls-and-icons
abstractionMatrix.rule: one interaction vocabulary; inline Lucide-compatible SVG; no ASCII arrows in canonical touched actions

abstractionMatrix.name: semantic-primitives
abstractionMatrix.rule: semantic role controls hierarchy; status meaning never depends on color alone

abstractionMatrix.name: surface-grammar
abstractionMatrix.rule: identity -> attention/purpose -> controls -> work -> context -> evidence/boundary

abstractionMatrix.name: procedure-specialization
abstractionMatrix.rule: specialize content and density, never fork design tokens or business authority

abstractionMatrix.name: responsive-motion-accessibility
abstractionMatrix.rule: geometry may change; authority, state and action meaning may not

abstractionMatrix.name: e2-falsification
abstractionMatrix.rule: style cannot override semantic/runtime correctness; CAPABILITY-CLOSURE-E2 remains blocking

minimalityRules.cardPolicy: single decision/narrative object or grouped summary only

globalDoD: 13 canonical surfaces remain represented exactly once in the convergence contract
seven business procedures retain existing business semantics and human decision authority
no second business write authority and no global final UI resolver
canonical first plane is minimal, role/action oriented and preserves material boundary information
repeated work defaults to rows/lists and compact controls rather than stacked card walls
critical interactive controls remain at least 44px high
canonical touched directional actions use SVG icons rather than ASCII arrows
micro-transitions are bounded and disabled/reduced when prefers-reduced-motion requests it
responsive changes geometry without changing semantic order, authority, state or action meaning
no enterprise-ready, legal/compliance, human-usability or deployment-effectiveness promotion

criteria: seven procedures share one frame grammar
GRC repeated records retain row/list grammar
AI settings stay subordinate and human-authority bounded
current semantic registry executes both saturation rails

localDoD: no bold long-form purpose/value paragraphs in canonical frame markup
Home priority rows carry short identity, reason and one open affordance
Process Hub rows carry code, title, one concise purpose and one route action
procedure frame uses icon back affordance and icon-enhanced primary action
critical touched controls are at least 44px high
micro-motion never exceeds the central motion budget
prefers-reduced-motion disables transforms and animated scrolling effects introduced by this pass
no source-level business route, subject, store or receipt contract is changed by this pass
claimBoundary: This candidate materially advances UIUX-CONVERGE-0 at E2 repository/runtime/UI level. It is not a terminal UIUX-CONVERGE-0 claim because C5 and final UXW-14 closure remain required. It does not prove representative human usability, assistive-technology effectiveness, production deployment effectiveness, protected-branch enforcement, legal compliance, certification, market fit or enterprise readiness.
